description: This file defines the LeaveOverlapParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for handling parameters related to leave overlaps within the OrangeHRM Leave module. The class extends LeaveParameterObject and provides methods that throw exceptions for unsupported operations, indicating it is used for read-only or placeholder purposes.

classes.name: LeaveOverlapParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing parameters for leave overlap checks, extending LeaveParameterObject, providing getter and setter methods with certain operations disabled.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type as an integer; throws a LogicException as operation is not permitted.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type; does nothing as the operation is not supported.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment; throws a LogicException as operation is not permitted.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment; does nothing as the operation is not supported.

methods.name: getLogicException
methods.description: Creates and returns a new LogicException indicating the operation is not allowed for this class.
